name: openkit-monorepo
description: OpenKit monorepo root package; ordinary turbo build, test, lint, and format tasks include @openkit/nanohost Cargo scripts

scripts.build: bash scripts/test-env.sh any bash -c 'turbo run build && esbuild skills/openkit-cli.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --minify --outfile=skills/openkit/scripts/openkit'
scripts.build:openkit: bash scripts/test-env.sh any bash -c 'pnpm --filter @openkit/core-client... build && esbuild skills/openkit-cli.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --minify --outfile=skills/openkit/scripts/openkit'
scripts.test: bash scripts/test-env.sh any node scripts/validate-test-governance.mjs --run -- turbo run test
scripts.typecheck: bash scripts/test-env.sh any turbo run typecheck
scripts.fmt: bash scripts/test-env.sh any turbo run format
scripts.lint: bash scripts/test-env.sh any turbo run lint
scripts.check:repo: bash scripts/test-env.sh any bash -c 'node scripts/validate-spec-lifecycle.mjs && node scripts/validate-story-schema.mjs && node scripts/validate-doc-model.mjs && node scripts/generate-doc-index.mjs --check && node scripts/validate-agent-interface-reachability.mjs && node scripts/validate-agent-session-terminology.mjs && node scripts/validate-test-governance.mjs && biome check . && pnpm --filter @openkit/models-dev-catalog test'
scripts.test:unit: bash scripts/test-env.sh any node scripts/validate-test-governance.mjs --run -- bash -c 'turbo run test && pnpm --filter @openkit/core-client... build && esbuild skills/openkit-cli.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --minify --outfile=skills/openkit/scripts/openkit && git diff --exit-code -- skills/openkit/scripts/openkit && node --test tests/*.test.mjs'
scripts.test:e2e:nano: bash scripts/test-env.sh any bash -c 'turbo run build --filter=@openkit/nanocore && pnpm --filter @openkit/nanocore run test:e2e'
scripts.test:e2e:web: bash scripts/test-env.sh any bash -c 'turbo run build --filter=@openkit/nanocore --filter=@openkit/web && pnpm --filter @openkit/web e2e'
scripts.test:smoke: bash scripts/test-env.sh any bash -c 'turbo run build --filter=@openkit/nanocore && node tests/smoke/nanocore-health-smoke.mjs && node tests/smoke/nanocore-worker-mcp-smoke.mjs && turbo run build --filter=@openkit/web && node tests/smoke/web-preview-smoke.mjs'
scripts.test:e2e:real-codex: bash scripts/test-env.sh host pnpm --filter @openkit/nanocore run test:e2e:real-codex
scripts.test:e2e:real-subscription:preflight: bash scripts/test-env.sh any bash -c 'pnpm --filter @openkit/nanocore... build && node --test apps/nanocore/e2e/provider-subscription-real-lifecycle-runner.test.mjs'
scripts.verify:l0-l2: pnpm run check:repo && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm build
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run verify:l0-l2 && pnpm run test:e2e:nano && pnpm run test:smoke
scripts.verify:full: pnpm run verify:l0-l2 && pnpm run test:e2e:nano && pnpm run test:e2e:web && pnpm run test:smoke
